conclusions: All 12 captures reproduced at least one long main-pass slow segment.
W1 transfers most explicit waiting into mapAsync; neither W1 nor R1 eliminates slow segments on both implementations.
Both A0/R1 captures enter P0 and have nearby desktop activity; lower GPU timings cannot be assigned solely to readback batching.
All three arms retain a per-frame completion dependency; the experiment has not tested removing the whole serial completion chain.
No production code or acceptance contract change, no promotion to baseline, and no 5% budget relaxation.
limits: 200 ms received clock samples are associations, not precise per-draw clock measurements.
No foreign overlap or selected paging event is not proof that all driver-internal mechanisms are absent.
DMA intervals contain scheduling and execution time; bPreempted=false does not exclude every kind of interruption.
Two rounds are a mechanism screen, not long-term stability qualification.
The next suggested interaction experiment is not implemented or validated by this report.
